title: What causes earthquakes?
snippet: Earthquakes occur when the ground is subjected to so much force that it fractures or breaks. Most earthquakes are associated with tectonic plate boundaries.

title: What is an earthquake and what causes them to happen?
snippet: An earthquake is caused by a sudden slip on a fault. The tectonic plates are always slowly moving, but they get stuck at their edges due to friction.

title: Earthquake facts and information
snippet: Most earthquakes occur at fault zones, where tectonic plates—giant rock slabs that make up Earth's upper layer—collide or slide against each other.

title: What Happens During an Earthquake?
snippet: Earthquakes occur along the boundaries between tectonic plates or at the site of cracks within the plates, which are called faults.
